pages.organisations.whatBody.source: Four courses for learners aged about 10 to 17. Exploring Our World: {ourWorld} lessons about history, geography, culture and civic life. Digital World: {digitalWorld} lessons about AI and the digital world. Southeast Asia Through Time: {southeastAsia} lessons about the region's past, from real objects, maps and letters. Art, Architecture and Society: {art} lessons about works and buildings from around the world. Most lessons have five steps: read, write, speak, watch and reflect (four where a lesson has no video, as every lesson does in Bahasa Indonesia, Bahasa Melayu and Tiếng Việt). It runs in a web browser on shared laptops and tablets, in English, Bahasa Indonesia, Bahasa Melayu or Tiếng Việt. Lessons work offline once a course is saved on the device; the optional videos need the internet.
pages.organisations.whatBody.back: 4 courses for learners aged about 10 to 17. Exploring our world: {ourWorld} lessons about history, geography, culture and civic life. Digital world: {digitalWorld} lessons about AI and the digital world. Southeast Asia through time: {southeastAsia} lessons about the region's past, through real objects, maps and letters. Art, architecture and society: {art} lessons about works and buildings from around the world. Most lessons have 5 steps: read, write, speak, watch and reflect (4 steps in lessons with no video, which is the case for every lesson in Thai, Indonesian, Malay and Vietnamese). It is used in a web browser on shared laptops and tablets, in English, Thai, Indonesian, Malay or Vietnamese. Lessons work even without internet once the course is saved on the device; the optional videos need the internet.

pages.about.missionBody.source: Thinkerwell began with a love of social studies and a question: how can more youth have the chance to explore the world they live in? We built a free digital platform to make digital learning tools and social studies education accessible to youth facing barriers to education. Our goal is to help learners ask questions, grow their critical thinking skills, explore diverse perspectives, and share their own ideas.

We built a free digital platform so that youth facing barriers in accessing education can access digital learning tools and social studies education. Our goal is to help learners ask questions, develop critical thinking skills, explore diverse perspectives and share their own ideas.

siteVideo.explore.p1.source: Every learner deserves the chance to explore the world they live in. But across Southeast Asia, many youth face barriers to education. In Myanmar, about 3.8 million people are displaced inside their own country. In Malaysia, refugee children can't attend government schools. And in East Asia and the Pacific, one in three school-age children had no internet at home.
siteVideo.explore.p1.back: Every learner should have the chance to explore the world they live in. But across Southeast Asia, many youth face barriers to education. In Myanmar, about 3.8 million people are displaced inside their own country. In Malaysia, refugee children can't attend government schools. And in East Asia and the Pacific, one in three school-age children has no internet at home.

siteVideo.explore.p2.source: Where schools are stretched, lessons often stick to the basics: reading, maths, and skills for a job. Those matter. But there's little room left for the skills that open up the world: thinking critically, communicating with evidence, and taking other perspectives.
siteVideo.explore.p2.back: Where schools don't have enough resources, lessons often focus only on the basics: reading, maths and skills for work. These matter, but leave very little room for the skills that open up the world: critical thinking, communicating with evidence and seeing from other people's perspectives.

siteVideo.explore.p3.source: Research backs this up. In a Stanford study, students who learned history by questioning real sources grew more in historical thinking, reading, and knowledge than students in regular classes.
siteVideo.explore.p3.back: Research supports this. In a Stanford study, students who learned history by questioning real sources developed more in historical thinking, reading and knowledge than students in regular classes.

siteVideo.explore.p4.source: That's why we built Thinkerwell: free lessons in social studies and beyond, for youth facing barriers to education. Our first course, Exploring Our World, has 24 lessons in history, geography, culture, and civic life, and every lesson has five steps: read, write, speak, watch and reflect. Every reading has a simpler version and can be read aloud, and lessons work offline, in several languages.
siteVideo.explore.p4.back: This is why we built Thinkerwell: free lessons in social studies and more, for youth facing barriers to education. Our first course, "Exploring our world", has 24 lessons in history, geography, culture and civic life, and every lesson has five steps: read, write, speak, watch and reflect. Every reading has a simpler version and can be listened to read aloud, and lessons work even without internet, in many languages.

siteVideo.explore.p5.source: Thinkerwell doesn't replace teachers. It lightens their load, with a ready-made guide for every lesson, plus answer keys and printables.
siteVideo.explore.p5.back: Thinkerwell doesn't replace teachers; it lightens teachers' load, with a ready-to-use guide for every lesson, plus answer keys and printable documents.

siteVideo.explore.p6.back: Our goal is to help learners ask questions, develop critical thinking skills, explore diverse perspectives and share their own ideas. Thinkerwell. Social studies and more. Explore your world.

siteVideo.session.p4.source: Pick any lesson. Its teacher guide has a plan for 30 or 45 minutes, with the answers. Then learners work through five steps. They read, in standard or simpler English. They write. They talk it through with a partner. They watch a short video, or read it instead. And they reflect.

aboutPage.studies.read.source: A randomized trial with children from kindergarten to grade 4 found that a program teaching reading through science and social studies helped them learn more of both. It tested a whole program, not reading alone, with younger learners in a different setting.

aboutPage.studies.speak.source: In a small science study, grade 8 students who were asked to explain a text to themselves understood it better than students who read it twice. It supports explaining your thinking, not any kind of talking.

privacy.intro.source: Thinkerwell provides free social studies learning for youth across Southeast Asia. We are committed to respecting learners’ privacy, dignity and safety. This policy covers our website, communications and learning activities. Its safeguarding commitments apply to everyone under 18 and to anyone working on Thinkerwell’s behalf.
privacy.intro.back: Thinkerwell provides free social studies learning for youth across Southeast Asia. We are committed to respecting learners' privacy, dignity and safety. This policy covers our website, communications and learning activities. The child protection commitments in this policy apply to everyone under 18 and to everyone working on Thinkerwell's behalf.
privacy.intro.note: The whole privacy group is a policy page translated faithfully; a native reviewer should read it in one go for accuracy and register (คุณ, careful but plain).

privacy.learnersBody.source: Use a nickname, avoid sharing sensitive personal information, and remember that others using your device may see your saved work. You can skip uncomfortable questions and ask a trusted adult for help.
privacy.learnersBody.back: Use a nickname, avoid sharing sensitive personal information, and remember that other people who use your device may see the work you saved. You can skip questions that make you feel uncomfortable, and ask a trusted adult for help.

privacy.s1.p1.source: Learner profiles, preferences, progress and journal responses are saved in the browser on the device used. Shared-device profiles should not be treated as password-protected accounts. Avoid entering addresses, contact details, identity documents or sensitive family information into learning activities. If a learner joins an online class with a code from their teacher, part of their progress is shared with that class (section 3).
privacy.s1.p1.back: Learners' profiles, chosen settings, progress and journal answers are saved in the browser on the device used. Profiles on a shared device should not be treated as password-protected accounts. Avoid entering addresses, contact details, identity documents or sensitive family information into learning activities. If a learner joins an online class with a code from the teacher, part of the learner's progress is shared with that class (section 3).

privacy.s1.p2.source: If you contact us, we receive the information you choose to provide, such as your email address and message. Website hosting and external services may also process technical information, including IP addresses and browser details. Thinkerwell uses information only for the purposes described in this policy.
privacy.s1.p2.back: If you contact us, we receive the information you choose to give, such as your email address and your message. The website hosting provider and external services may also process technical information, including IP addresses and browser details. Thinkerwell uses information only for the purposes described in this policy.

privacy.s2.p1.source: We limit personal information to what is necessary to provide learning, operate and secure Thinkerwell, respond to enquiries and address safety concerns. We do not sell learners’ personal information or distribute it for advertising or unrelated purposes. Limited sharing is restricted to the service, safeguarding and legal purposes described here. We do not use personal information for targeted advertising or identifiable learner work to train third-party, non-local AI models.
privacy.s2.p1.back: We limit personal information to what is necessary to provide learning, operate and secure Thinkerwell, answer questions and handle safety concerns. We don't sell learners' personal information, and don't distribute it for advertising or other unrelated purposes. Limited sharing of information is only for providing the service, child protection and the legal purposes described here. We don't use personal information for targeted advertising, and don't use identifiable learner work to train third-party AI models that don't run on the device.
privacy.s2.p1.note: "third-party, non-local AI models" rendered as โมเดล AI ของบุคคลที่สามที่ไม่ได้ทำงานบนอุปกรณ์ (models that don't run on the device). "non-local" is ambiguous in English (not on the device, or outside the region); confirm the intended meaning with the team before a reviewer polishes it. Legal text: check nothing was added or softened.

privacy.s2.stats.source: We will collect anonymised, aggregated numerical statistics about platform usage and engagement, such as total visits, lesson activity and feature usage. These statistics help us understand Thinkerwell’s reach and improve the learning experience. They will exclude names, contact details and journal content, and will not identify individual learners. We will not attempt to re-identify anyone from this information.
privacy.s2.stats.back: We will collect anonymised numerical statistics, combined into an overall picture, about use of and engagement with the platform, such as total visits, lesson activity and use of features. These statistics help us understand how many people Thinkerwell reaches and improve the learning experience. They will not include names, contact details or journal content, and will not identify individual learners. We will not try to re-identify anyone from this information.

privacy.s2.statsNow.source: Thinkerwell does not collect these statistics yet. Nothing on the site counts visits, lessons or features today.
privacy.s2.statsNow.back: Thinkerwell doesn't collect these statistics yet. Nothing on the website today counts visits, lessons or features.

privacy.s2.coded.source: An optional feature for pilot partners could link usage data to learner codes. It is switched off for everyone, and nothing is collected through it. Coded data is not anonymous, so it is separate from the statistics above. Any pilot data collection is agreed with each organisation first, with the permissions it needs.
privacy.s2.coded.back: An optional feature for partner organisations during a pilot could link usage data to learner codes. This feature is off for everyone, and no information is collected through it. Data linked to codes is not anonymous, so it is separate from the statistics above. Any data collection during a pilot is agreed with each organisation first, with the permissions needed.

privacy.s2.p3.source: Where consent is required, we explain the purpose clearly and obtain appropriate consent, including from a parent or legal guardian for children under 13 and whenever otherwise required.
privacy.s2.p3.back: Where consent is needed, we explain the purpose clearly and ask for appropriate consent, including from a parent or legal guardian for children under 13, and in every case where it is required.

privacy.s4.p1.source: We restrict access to information we hold and use reasonable security measures. We retain it only as long as needed for its stated purpose or legal obligations, then delete or anonymise it. If a data breach occurs, we assess it and notify affected people and authorities where required.
privacy.s4.p1.back: We restrict access to information we keep and use reasonable security measures. We keep information only as long as needed for the stated purpose or legal obligations, then delete it or make it anonymous. If a data breach happens, we assess the incident and notify affected people and relevant authorities where required.

privacy.s4.p2.source: Contact us to request access, correction, deletion or withdrawal of consent. We will explain any applicable limits. Clearing Thinkerwell’s browser data can remove all locally saved profiles and work on that browser. We cannot remotely retrieve or erase information held only on your device. Others with access to that browser may still be able to see it.
privacy.s4.p2.back: Contact us to ask for access, correction or deletion of information, or to withdraw consent. We will explain any limits that may apply. Clearing Thinkerwell's browser data may delete all profiles and work saved in that browser. We cannot remotely retrieve or delete information that is only on your device. Others who can access that browser may still see that information.

privacy.s4.remove.source: On the “Who’s learning today?” screen, Remove deletes one learner’s lesson work, journal, section check scores and recordings from that device. It cannot be undone.
privacy.s4.remove.back: On the "Who will learn today?" page, the "Remove" button deletes one learner's lesson work, journal, section check scores and recordings from that device. It can't be undone.

Check against the pages agent's pages.home.title and pages.home.remove.action and make them match exactly. Reviewer (second pass): checked: “วันนี้ใครจะเรียน?” is pages.home.title and “นำออก” is pages.home.remove.action, exactly. Flag removed.

privacy.s5.p1.source: We prohibit abuse, exploitation, harassment, bullying and discrimination. Team members must follow safeguarding conduct rules and receive preparation and suitability checks appropriate to their roles. Direct learner sessions must have responsible adult supervision; secret contact and unsupervised private sessions are prohibited.
privacy.s5.p1.back: We prohibit abuse, exploitation, harassment, bullying and discrimination. Team members must follow child protection conduct rules and receive preparation and suitability checks suited to their role. Sessions directly with learners must have a responsible adult supervising. Secret contact and private sessions without supervision are prohibited.

privacy.s5.p2.source: We review materials for age suitability. Learners and organisations may skip sensitive activities or use fictional examples without sharing personal experiences. Partners and Thinkerwell must agree on supervision, consent and local reporting arrangements before joint activities.
privacy.s5.p2.back: We review learning materials for age suitability. Learners and organisations can skip sensitive activities, or use fictional examples without telling personal experiences. Partner organisations and Thinkerwell must agree on supervision, consent and local reporting channels before doing activities together.

privacy.s6.p1.source: We do not routinely record learner sessions. Using identifiable images, recordings, quotations or work requires specific parent or guardian permission and the child’s agreement. Refusing does not affect learning access. Permission never justifies material that could put a child at risk.
privacy.s6.p1.back: We don't normally record learner sessions. Using identifiable images, audio or video recordings, quotations or work needs specific permission from a parent or guardian and the child's agreement. Refusing doesn't affect access to learning. Permission is never a reason to use material that could put a child at risk.

privacy.s7.p1.source: Contact {email} for privacy requests, unsuitable content or safeguarding concerns. Share only necessary details. Reports will be taken seriously, handled without retaliation and shared only with people who need to respond. Absolute secrecy cannot be promised where protection or legal reporting requires disclosure. Concerns involving team members must receive independent handling.
privacy.s7.p1.back: Contact {email} for privacy requests, unsuitable content or child protection concerns. Give only the details needed. We will take reports seriously, handle them without retaliation against the reporter, and share them only with people who need to act. We can't promise complete confidentiality where child protection or legal reporting requires disclosure. Concerns involving team members must be handled independently.
privacy.s7.p1.note: Legal-ish wording: "handled without retaliation" is จัดการโดยไม่มีการตอบโต้ผู้แจ้ง, "must receive independent handling" is ต้องได้รับการจัดการอย่างเป็นอิสระ. Check both are accurate and not softened.

privacy.s7.p2.source: Journals are not monitored for safety concerns, and our inbox is not an emergency service. For immediate danger, contact local emergency services or a safe, trusted adult.
privacy.s7.p2.back: We don't monitor journals for safety concerns, and our email inbox is not an emergency service. In immediate danger, contact local emergency services or a safe, trusted adult.

privacy.s7.p3.source: We review this policy annually and after significant changes or incidents, and publish its latest revision date.
privacy.s7.p3.back: We review this policy every year and after significant changes or incidents, and publish the latest revision date.
